reviewer_role: Independent requirements-and-proposal coverage challenger; not clean-room runtime validation
scope: Planning only; read-only raw evidence, no product execution, no CLI, no Git, no source audit repetition, no statuses changed

omission_checklist.requirement: Every responsibility has an explicit retained, repair, library replacement, conditional adoption or blocked owner disposition; contextual family mapping never proves every duty.

All 333 remaining-work identities including 10 auxiliary gate/handoff records, all 323 ideal DAG task identities and all 114 required/conditional/deferred/declined finished duties have an exact crosswalk; original subtask identities and acceptance remain independently recoverable.

Library/centralization candidates retain actual required domain, first error, ordering, callbacks, immutable carriers and public exports; keep retained TS ICU/timezone/locale, unknown JS traversal, protocol profiles, SDK/browser/storage/provider ownership. Dependency import cost, pack closure, license/version and upgrade obligations stay explicit.

A public or externally callable helper with no observed in-repo caller is not dead; test-only, type-only, generated, conditional and prototype status stay separate. Retirement requires exact matching mechanism body and complete actual consumer/caller-domain negative evidence, including rollback successor.

Preserve bigint/int64/Decimal scale/negative-zero/f64 bits, UTF16 lone surrogates, missing/null/undefined, own duplicate keys, integer-index enumeration, getter/proxy/prototype/toJSON and reference/default identity distinctions; no universal serializer or clone inferred from names.

Raw state receipt hash ordering/profile/version remains separate from normalized CSV candidates/media mapping/export descriptor hashes. Safe provider failures use trusted adapter-owned fields/templates, not free-text blacklist/hash secrecy. Secret current read/CRUD/replay/changed-record projection refusal is qualified per actual consumer.

Type-directed blank mapping, schema header/protected/overlap validation, normalized duplicate detection, frozen row/index/input consent, source-row commit order, user/app/team/session/24h lifecycle, and replay-before-unseen-age authority handling retain invalid/unselected/partial/unknown outcomes; parser allocation/URL props remain owning consumer gates.

One canonical commit engine with dense monotone fence, rollback of staged rows/history/uniques/outbox, current live authority and owning tenant/store correspondence; own-property SQL metadata lookup; public and trusted exceptions precise. Replay receipt namespace/projection/retention precedes unseen validation without repeating effects.

Origin/CSRF proof, bounded grant body, exact PKCE validation, presession browser binding, single-use winner outcomes, password/revocation cascades, last-owner and role concurrency require explicit typed context/fence participant agreement before implementations. A registered command or separate IdentityStore is not the real atomic join.

Upload semantic operation/field authority; exact chunk/retry/count bytes and digest; recoverable blob/metadata finalization; provider origin/dedup; current attachment/download record authority; retention/sweep/tombstones/quotas; no imaginary atomic R2+state transaction, memory alias crash proof or filesystem traversal promise beyond actual host.

Atomic joined outbox/dispatch, held claim generation, guard order, exact intent/provider identity and first-attempt horizon, uncertainty/reconciliation, occurrence admission, schedule supersession and recurrence durable joins, act-time rereads; lease expiry never implies provider cancellation or unknown becomes failure.

Frozen full identity membership, current child retry/body facts, same-fanout terminal/checkpoint converse coverage, stale-release continuation/fair termination, honest pending/attention/cancel; page caps never replace total cohort or truncate business results.

Byte/depth/node/count/CPU and scan/memory resource limits precede costly admitted parsing/hash/materialization where promised, retain complete all-or-reject semantics. Real cancellation/cleanup joins provider/body/SDK/testkit/native/Bun resources; timeout/retry age is not physical interruption. No new threshold chosen by audit.

Ownership before graph exposure, genuine lineage, schema/default/ref admission and first-failure trace, TS/native handle-generation-capacity parity, partial registration cleanup, owner disposal and stale/foreign/released tokens. Freeze/snapshot does not create provenance; selected native trap/error never reruns TS.

68-component shell/page-admission/typed asset/client/DOM/focus/unsaved-state workflows; stale context checked through body completion, physical polling cancellation evidence, upload/result retry and expiring export/download/Print lifecycle. Preferences authority/default/reset/version/ref and pure server CSV review remain required joins.

Keep corpus all-used-context grounded authority, lifetime/erasure, mailbox/payments/documents/connector/onboard/judgment/invocation/tracker/report/alerts/maintenance/ping/instrumentation/source mappings and original app intent requirements visible. Contract/stub/source helpers/501 refuse truthfully but do not close advertised workflows.

Human hold on native preparation persists despite required native semantic outcome; retained synchronous TS helpers and current CLI behavior remain. One retained native job preserves artifact/companion/compat/confirmation/activation/module/Bun/catalog/plan/prior/review/publication/apply order and host observables; native cannot synthesize active app or missing authority.

Exact reviewed byte/key set, symlink containment, platform-bootstrap namespace, bounded Bun scratch/process cleanup, native frame/diagnostic/whole-job queue limits, sidecar consistency and honest partial/manual recovery; source-selected CLI writer distinct from held helper.

Acyclic source/export/build/lock/tarball closure; installed release producer facts resolve outside checkout; actual final values/work glue+Wasm assets, kind/byte/hash/version inventory, eager startup before synchronous calls, explicit qualified backend selection and fail-closed init; tiny loader smoke is prerequisite only. Native host/packaging choice and rollback economics remain bounded and conditional.

Exact predecessor/desired source schemas, validated staging and retained pending work, fenced maintenance/publish/installed pointer, failure and forward-only recovery are required; online/universal transfer remains separate. Receipt/fence/content/secret retention and disposal duties not silently pruned.

Future actual caller/comparator mutant negatives must challenge scalar/extra/identity/order/privacy/lifecycle mismatches; independent fixture expectations, real D1/DO/backend/provider/browser/installed paths and original authored source. Historical tests/source labels/producers/pack bytes are evidence only at declared scope; no new runtime or global acceptance.

Exact file owners/reservations, dependency successors and cycle handling; local readiness separate from execution authorization and holds. Repairs wait only for consequential interface agreements; migration required when actual API/bytes/identity/authority changes, not every equivalent internal replacement. No source-task status mutation or selected default/adoption/retirement inferred from planning.
